history.shared_categories: American (Traditional), Bars, Cajun/Creole, Cocktail Bars, Nightlife, Restaurants

text.text_excerpt: This place is really getting the business they deserve. The food has lots of flavor! The variety of dishes are amazing. I had the grilled shrimp and fish over sauteed spinach. It was a light dish, but it was delicious. My daughter had pasta with a seafood creamy sauce. When I looked around at the restaurant, I noticed one guy was licking his plate after eating (lol). If you like food with a spicy kick, the seafood eggrolls are delish. The service is friendly and very attentive. Even the security gaurd was very helpful and asked if we needed a bag for our to-go box and he got it for us, opened the door and was very friendly. This place is a neighorhood favorite of mine.

I have been here multiple times, with a group and for takeout. We have eaten a number of items and the worst review was for the green beans. Overall the food has been yummy. The menu is really seafood forward and I think the favorite item so far is the sandwich on the bun. The bun is on the Hawaiian bread side and just tastes good with the well spiced shrimp. I also like stuffed bell pepper which comes with a large portion of the seafood pasta/seafood mac and cheese. If you are not a fan of well seasoned food or have high blood pressure, you may want to let them know because they do season everything well. The drinks are strong enough to make you feel it but not so strong that you can't k...

Fire Food and Spirits don't owe me nothing!!!. My entire experience was amazing. This place is lowkey not quite the look of a restaurant but moreso of a bar however they have tables and chairs and a bar as well. We ordered the Grilled Oysters, Crawfish Fries, Half Seafood Platter, Red Beans and Rice and a Fish dish. All of it was awesome. Some food came out before others but I expected that because it was freshly fried. It was piping hot and very very flavorful. I have no complaints about anything really. The owner was very nice. He came to our table and talked to us more than once. Everybody was in a happy mood. I felt like I was at home really.
